Title: Azure Resource Manager support in runbooks

Body.Content: Azure Automation now provides the AzureRM.profile and AzureRM.Compute Azure Resource Manager PowerShell modules as global modules for use in your runbooks. This includes side-by-side use with the Azure Service Management cmdlets. For more information, see the announcement blog post, Azure Resource Manager support in runbooks.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Automation now provides the AzureRM.profile and AzureRM.Compute Azure Resource Manager PowerShell modules as global modules for use in your runbooks. This includes side-by-side use with the Azure Service Management cmdlets.

For more information, see the announcement blog post, Azure Resource Manager support in runbooks .
